summary: Onboarding kit courier hold and MFA badge mismatch for EU contractor
description: Issue summary: Contractor preboarding kit (laptop + dock + VPN router + ergonomic kit) is staged at the London facilities distribution desk but courier hold flagged the package due to an MFA/badge provisioning mismatch. Facilities logged a hold because the contractor's badge ID in Okta does not match the manifest used by the courier. Impact: Onboarding start date at risk (contractor cannot access building for desk setup), equipment may miss first-week delivery, and VPN router pickup/return window needs coordination. Location: London HQ, Receiving Bay B, staging shelf 3. Items affected: 1x MacBook Pro (asset tag RWI-26712), 1x Dell dock (asset tag RWI-26713), 1x VPN router (asset tag RWI-26714), ergonomic footrest + monitor arm kit. Intended recipient: external contractor (vendor) onboarding to Platform team, start date 2026-03-09. Manifest ID: COURIER-88921. Badge record reference: Okta user id okta|ext:4519.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Facilities schedules a courier pickup for preboarding kits using manifest COURIER-88921.
2) Couriers scan package and compare recipient badge ID against the electronic manifest.
3) Access desk attempts to badge-in the contractor at arrival; system rejects badge code due to mismatch.
4) Courier places package on hold per SOP.
Note: mismatch occurs reproducibly when courier manifest badge_id != Okta badge_id synced to Access database.
impact: Contractor delayed from on-site setup; Platform onboarding tasks (VPN provisioning, desk allocation) can't be completed. Potential knock-on delays for lab access and scheduled training in week one.
investigation: Initial findings: Facilities confirmed staged items and manifest COURIER-88921. Access team inspected Okta entry and discovered external contractor record created by People Ops with temporary badge token ext-4519. Couriers received manifest with badge token ext-4520 (off by one digit). Hypothesis: People Ops exported CSV from HRIS, manual increment introduced during CSV edit. Verified courier scan logs timestamped 2026-03-05 09:12:04 showing scanned badge token ext-4520 and reject code REJ-03 (badge-not-found). CCTV confirms package remained on staging shelf at 09:20. VPN router return window noted in asset management (return by 2026-04-09).
comments: 2026-03-05 10:02 - Priya Shah: Raised to Facilities after courier hold. Asked for photos of manifest and staging shelf. Action: Facilities to retain kit and escalate to Access and People Ops.

2026-03-05 11:15 - Facilities (Liam O'Connor): Uploaded manifest photo and package photo. Confirmed asset tags match internal records. Manifest shows badge ext-4520. Keeping kit on hold until badge mismatch resolved.

2026-03-05 12:30 - Access (Aisha Khan): Checked Okta: contractor entry okta|ext:4519. Submitted ticket to People Ops to verify original import. Recommended temporary guest pass for contractor on start date as contingency.

2026-03-06 09:45 - People Ops (Marisol Vega): Confirmed CSV edit error — badge token column accidentally shifted during copy/paste. Corrected record; new badge token ext-4520 was the erroneous value; canonical value is ext-4519. Re-running sync to Access scheduled at 10:00 UTC.
next_steps:
1) People Ops to re-sync corrected badge token to Okta and Access DB, confirm propagation to Access control (ETA 2026-03-06 10:15).
2) Facilities to keep kit staged and hold courier release until Access confirms green.
3) If sync fails or propagation delay >2 hours, issue temporary guest pass for contractor on 2026-03-09 and schedule on-site desk setup by Facilities to accept identification manually.
4) Schedule VPN router pickup/return window with Networking to avoid missed handoff.
resolution: Temporary workaround applied: People Ops corrected badge token and re-synced to Access; Access confirmed new entry at 2026-03-06 10:05 UTC. Facilities released kit to courier for next pickup (COURIER-88932) with updated manifest. VPN router pickup scheduled for 2026-03-10 to allow contractor remote-first setup on day one. Follow-up: update People Ops CSV import checklist and add a 2-person verification step for manifests.
postmortem_follow_up: Create a short retro with People Ops, Facilities, and Access to add a CSV import validation and manifest verification step. Target: implement checklist by 2026-03-20.
owner_notes: Assignee (Marco): coordinate pickup release and confirm courier ETA. Notify Platform hiring manager of mitigation.
